sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Administration module is accessible only to Controllers. It provides CRUD operations for organizational master data (Tier 1), portfolio hierarchy configuration, and planning parameter management (Tier 2). All changes are logged in the audit trail.

sections.title: Entity Type Selector
sections.body: The left panel organizes manageable items into three categories. **Entities** includes: Cost Centers, Competence Centers, Lines of Business, Locations, People, and Rate Tables. **Portfolio Structure** provides access to the Portfolio Hierarchy configuration panel. **System** contains Planning Parameters and the Audit Log. Select any item to see its management view on the right.

sections.title: CRUD Operations
sections.body: For each entity type, you can create new entries, edit existing ones, and deactivate records. **Important:** {app_name} uses deactivation instead of deletion — deactivated records are hidden from active views but preserved for historical accuracy. Deactivation may cascade (e.g., deactivating a cost center affects its people).

sections.title: Cost Center Management
sections.body: Create cost centers with a name, location, and competence center assignment. Edit to change assignments. Deactivate to remove from active views while preserving allocation history.

sections.title: People Management
sections.body: Add people with name, role type, and cost center assignment. Edit to transfer between cost centers or change roles. Deactivate when someone leaves. The system preserves all historical allocations and cost calculations.

sections.title: Rate Table Management
sections.body: View and update hourly rates per role per competence center. When updating a rate, set the new effective date. The system preserves the previous rate and effective date for audit purposes. Historical cost calculations always use the rate that was in effect at the time.

sections.title: Portfolio Hierarchy Management
sections.body:
The Portfolio Hierarchy panel (under Portfolio Structure) lets you configure how projects are grouped across the application. It has four sub-tabs:

**Entity Types** — Define grouping categories such as Business Unit, Initiative, or Division. Each type has a name and optional description.

**Hierarchies** — Arrange entity types into ordered levels to form a tree structure. One hierarchy can be marked as **Active** — this determines the grouping used across all modules. Only one hierarchy can be active at a time.

**Grouping Entities** — Create and manage the actual entities within each type (e.g., 'Manufacturing Systems' under Business Unit, 'Smart Factory Platform' under Initiative). Set parent-child relationships between entities of different types.

**Hierarchy Assignment** — View the active hierarchy as a tree and see which projects are assigned to which entities. Drag or reassign projects between entities.

The active hierarchy's labels propagate across **Portfolio Overview** (tree grouping and filters), **Capacity Management** (pivot dimensions), **Project Workbench** (entity selector fields), and **Reporting** (filter and dimension labels).

sections.title: Planning Parameters
sections.body:
Configure system-wide settings organized into six groups:

**Fiscal Settings** — Fiscal Year Start Month.
**Planning Horizon** — Number of planning years ahead.
**Thresholds** — RAG thresholds (Amber and Red percentages for variance-based status calculations).
**Limits** — Maximum Scenarios per User and other system caps.
**Capacity Settings** — Target Utilization percentage for capacity planning.
**Integrations** — API key management for external services. The Anthropic API key (used by the AI Report Builder) is stored here as a secret parameter with masked display. Use the **eye icon** to temporarily reveal the key value. Each group has its own **Save** and **Reset to Defaults** controls.

sections.title: Audit Trail
sections.body: All administrative changes are logged with timestamp, who made the change, what entity was affected, the specific field changed, and old/new values. The audit log is visible at the bottom of the Administration module.
